experiment: canonical chain on the 233-subject new-subject holdout (prereg Addendum F, corrected)
protocol: train once on the 728 subjects with all six modalities, predict the holdout subjects never used. g and w fixed at the 753-tuned values; lambda chosen by 10-fold CV inside the 728.
features_IMPORTANT: OUR OWN Schaefer-400 extraction (pool.npz resting-state + task_merged task FC), NOT the published Ooi matrices. The Ooi file has no task FC outside the 753, so the published-feature chain cannot be run on this holdout at all. The 728-subject CV here (0.7165) is the internal reference for this feature set, not the 0.7344 published-feature number.
cohort: 233 of the parallel session's 263 holdout ids that have all six modalities in our pool and a varimax_cog score

D1_benchmark_protocol.definition: kernel built over train+holdout together with no labels (transductive, as the benchmark does), filter included

D0_strict_inductive.definition: rows centred on the train mean, norms and double centring from the train block only, no filter

correction: earlier runs of this script used a lambda grid whose lower edge (0.03) was selected, costing ~0.10; widened to 1e-4..30 and the result moved 0.6741 -> 0.7721. The D0 arm had a broadcasting bug in the reference-block centring, fixed.
note: this is the canonical pipeline applied to our own extraction. It is the right comparison for the parallel session's 450-parcel re-extraction (their D1), not for the published-feature 0.7344.
